clue.text: To abandon plane is not shocking

parts.note: a jet is a kind of aeroplane

indicators.note: shocking letters are jolted out of their order, so the words is not are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark that leaving an aircraft behind is nothing to be alarmed about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shocking' looks like part of the statement 'is not shocking', but it rearranges IS NOT into TISON after JET.
explanation.definitionFit: To jettison something is to discard or throw it overboard.

clue.text: Drink European journalists fitted in well

indicators.note: fitted in means the journalists are placed inside the word for well

parts.note: so, as in 'so, what now?', is an interjection like well
the press is a collective term for journalists

explanation.surface: A European drink that reporters managed to squeeze in nicely.
explanation.definitionFit: Espresso is a strong black coffee, a drink.

clue.text: Solicitor eats river fish

indicators.note: eats means the solicitor takes the river letter inside

parts.note: a tout is someone who solicits custom

explanation.surface: A lawyer dines on a fish caught in the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solicitor' suggests a lawyer, but here it is a tout, one who solicits trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A trout is a freshwater fish of the salmon family.

clue.text: Is it spouted by one getting in a lather?

definitions.text: Is it spouted by one getting in a lather?

parts.words: Is it spouted by one getting in a lather?
parts.note: a ranting orator 'in a lather' is agitated, while the lather also suggests soap, the crate a street speaker stands on

explanation.surface: A question about what someone in a frothy state might be blurting out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a lather' means worked up, and soap makes lather; street ranters traditionally stood on a soap crate to harangue passers-by.
explanation.definitionFit: Impassioned, emotional public speechmaking of the street-corner kind is called this.

clue.text: Buddhists would like this vehicle when caught in swirling rain

indicators.note: caught in means the vehicle is enclosed by the other letters
swirling stirs the letters of rain into a new order

parts.note: a van is a road vehicle

explanation.surface: Buddhist monks hoping for a ride when stuck in a rainstorm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swirling' rearranges RAIN into NIRA, and 'caught in' places VAN inside it after NIR.
explanation.definitionFit: Nirvana, release from the cycle of rebirth, is the goal Buddhists seek.

clue.text: Move fast to secure some novel opening

indicators.note: to secure some says a run of letters is held within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Advice to dash off and get hold of a first chance at writing.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Move fast to secure' as the definition, but only 'Move fast' means the answer; 'to secure some' is the hidden-word signal, LOPE spanning novEL OPEning.
explanation.definitionFit: To lope is to run with long easy strides, a fast gait.

clue.text: Forced halts before going round French mountain some time ago

indicators.note: going round means the rearranged letters enclose the mountain
forced letters are wrenched out of shape, so halts is rearranged

parts.note: mont is French for mountain

explanation.surface: Unscheduled stops on a trip around an Alpine peak, a while back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forced' rearranges HALTS into LASTH, and 'going round' puts MONT inside it after LAST.
explanation.definitionFit: The previous month is a period some weeks in the past.

clue.text: Power cut will limit steep kind of profits

indicators.note: will limit means the first pair of pieces bounds the steep word, sitting on either side of it

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics
ax is the American spelling of axe, to cut
to ret is to steep flax or hemp in water

explanation.surface: A blackout restricting steep rises in company earnings.
explanation.walkthrough: RET, an old word for soaking flax, is inside PAX, made of P and AX (American 'axe').
explanation.definitionFit: Earnings counted before tax is deducted are reported as such figures.

clue.text: There will be something fishy in developments here!

definitions.text: There will be something fishy in developments here!

parts.words: There will be something fishy in developments here!
parts.note: 'something fishy' sounds like suspicious dealings at a building development, but the developments are young fish growing from eggs

explanation.surface: A warning that a property development hides some shady business.
explanation.definitionFit: Fish lay their eggs at a particular site, where the young then hatch and grow.

clue.text: Cessation of breathing one corrected in a parent

indicators.note: in means the rearranged letters sit inside the other pieces

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, a parent

indicators.note: corrected means the letters of one are put right into a new order

explanation.surface: A father with a breathing problem having one put right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corrected' rearranges ONE into NOE, which goes inside A PA.
explanation.definitionFit: Apnoea is the medical term for a temporary halt in respiration, as in sleep.

clue.text: Thrust in fencing split toes badly

parts.note: to rip is to tear or split

indicators.note: badly means the letters of toes are jumbled

explanation.surface: A fencer's lunge goes wrong and tears the toes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges TOES into OSTE after RIP.
explanation.definitionFit: A riposte is a quick return lunge after parrying in fencing.

clue.text: Ever the initial flexible support -for the neck?

indicators.note: flexible means the letters bend into another arrangement
initial picks the opening letter of the word the

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: Advertising copy for a bendy neck brace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flexible' rearranges EVER plus T (the initial of 'the') into VERTE, then BRA follows. The definition is cryptic: one of the cervical bones is in the neck.
explanation.definitionFit: Seven of these spinal bones form the neck, so one belongs there.

clue.text: Marsupial animal develops here given a little time

parts.note: the womb is where an unborn animal grows
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Where a pouched animal grows, given a short while.
explanation.walkthrough: Marsupial young actually leave the womb early to finish developing in a pouch, which gives the surface its twist.
explanation.definitionFit: The wombat is a burrowing Australian pouched mammal.

clue.text: Blue murder?

parts.note: 'blue murder' is a loud fuss, but read literally it is killing that turns the victim blue from lack of air

explanation.surface: Someone screaming blue murder about something.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'scream blue murder' is to protest noisily; the clue reads it as a killing in which the victim turns blue.
explanation.definitionFit: Suffocation starves the body of oxygen and turns the skin bluish, a deadly method.

clue.text: One's death could be shown by this

definitions.text: One's death could be shown by this

parts.words: One's death could be shown by this
parts.note: reads like a symptom or omen of dying, but means the marker set over a grave giving the date of death

explanation.surface: A grim sign or omen that someone is going to die.
explanation.definitionFit: A grave marker records the name and date of death of the person buried.

clue.text: Scope given one as a result of determination to achieve sue-cess

parts.note: ambit means range or scope
I is the Roman numeral for one
on can mean because of, as in 'acting on advice'

explanation.surface: Being given room to act leads to a drive to get ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambition is a strong desire to succeed and get on in life.

clue.text: Easy marching could become something terrible

indicators.note: could become means the letters of the two words turn into something new

explanation.surface: A gentle march could turn into a disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could become' rearranges the twelve letters of EASY MARCHING.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used of an unfortunate state of affairs, a great pity.

clue.text: Person who is a member of new team in Ireland

indicators.note: in means the new team goes inside the abbreviation for Ireland

parts.note: a side is a team in sport

explanation.surface: Someone who has joined a newly formed Irish team.
explanation.walkthrough: N and SIDE go inside IR.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone within a group or organisation, as opposed to an outsider, is one.

clue.text: Green ship must be covered in battleship colour?

indicators.note: must be covered in means the ship abbreviation is wrapped inside the colour

parts.note: battleship grey, spelt gray in American English, is the dull colour of warships
SS is the prefix for steamship

explanation.surface: A green ship has to be painted over in the navy's grey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green' looks like a colour to paint over; it is the definition, as in grassy meadows.
explanation.definitionFit: Grass-covered ground is green, so the adjective means verdant.

clue.text: Cheers professionals having the desired quality

parts.note: pros is short for professionals
'it' is that special appeal or quality everyone wants

explanation.surface: Applause for experts who have that special something.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosit is a German toast meaning 'may it benefit you', said when raising a glass.

clue.text: Unusual phrase I'm using for heavenly creatures

indicators.note: unusual means the letters are put into a strange new order

explanation.surface: Using an odd turn of phrase to describe angels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusual' rearranges the letters of PHRASE I'M.
explanation.definitionFit: Seraphim are the highest order of angels in Christian tradition.

clue.text: Pair will reach nocturnal bird in search for prey

parts.note: the owl is a night-flying bird

explanation.surface: Two night birds out hunting together.
explanation.definitionFit: To prowl is to roam stealthily hunting for food.

clue.text: Turned round about and S cleansed thoroughly

indicators.note: round means the word for turned is placed around the about abbreviation

parts.note: milk that has turned has soured
C is short for circa, about

explanation.surface: Something spun round and scrubbed clean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned round' reads as one phrase, but 'Turned' is SOURED and 'round' places it around C.
explanation.definitionFit: To scour is to scrub hard until clean.

clue.text: Turn first-class trophy over: B everything's perfect here

parts.note: a U-turn gives U for turn

indicators.note: over means the words for first-class and trophy are read backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, and the figure 1 stands for the letter I
a pot is slang for a sporting trophy

explanation.surface: Flip the top prize upside down: all is ideal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns A1 POT into TOPIA (the 1 read as I), after U.
explanation.definitionFit: Utopia is an imagined ideal society, a perfect place.

clue.text: Cowshed in Whitby region

indicators.note: in says the answer sits within the letters of the next words

explanation.surface: A cattle shed in the Yorkshire area around Whitby, a seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: BYRE spans whitBY REgion; Whitby is a North Yorkshire fishing town.
explanation.definitionFit: A byre is a barn for cattle, chiefly in Scotland and northern England.

clue.text: Reminiscent of cut to limit un- unemployment benefit

indicators.note: to limit means the word for cut bounds the benefit on both sides

parts.note: a rent is a tear or cut
the dole is British slang for unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: A reminder of the government cap placed on jobless payments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' seems to describe the benefit cut, but it is RENT, a tear, around DOLE (British slang for state unemployment pay).
explanation.definitionFit: Redolent of means strongly evocative of or suggesting something.
